name: Haikky Vomp
kurzbeschreibung: **Hike the Vomp in Vomp** Discover the breathtaking **Haikky Vomp** in the charming village of **Vomp**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This scenic trail takes you through lush meadows, past crystal-clear streams, and up to stunning viewpoints overlooking the **Inntal** valley. Whether you're an experienced hiker or a nature enthusiast, this route offers unforgettable panoramas and a true taste of **Tirol**’s natural beauty. Start your adventure at the **Vomp** village center, where you can also indulge in local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel** before or after your hike. Don’t forget to explore the traditional **Tiroler** architecture and cozy cafés along the way! **More about Tirol**
